description: One of the largest geothermal borehole fields in Wallonia: 93 vertical boreholes of 140 m for the Aerospacelab Megafactory in Charleroi. On site from February 2023 to the end of 2025. This major project confirms WellDoneDrill's expertise in large-scale industrial works.
title: Aerospacelab Megafactory — Charleroi
